AN IN-HOUSE FINDING THAT CHEAPENED THE DESIGN, worth not losing: charter/projector.py ALREADY settles the bounded-read contract — project() returns {cursor, window, count} with 'count = the full length, so the window's boundedness stays visible' (verbatim the Law 7 requirement a scrollable diagnostic pane needs), and _window() already dispatches on a rule dict. Consequently BOTH coinages I offered Akien this session are WITHDRAWN: `watch` and `parcel`/`manifest` would be near-synonyms beside `window` (bound across 19 charters) and beside the ledger's `deposited` records. The shared-noun question I put to him DISSOLVES rather than needing his ruling — [[terms-drift-flag-coinages]] caught at n=1.

ONE HONEST NOTE ON THIS SLATE ITSELF: it was written AFTER both roots were committed and pushed, verified by instrument — deliberately, because the reverse is exactly the bug that seeded nothing-rides-loose this morning.
